title: Commercial Real Estate Appraisal
description: A narrative appraisal of a commercial property, as read by lenders, investors, auditors and asset managers: who prepared it and for whom, what the property is, and the value conclusion with the approaches behind it.

assignment.description: Who prepared the appraisal, for whom, and why, from the cover and transmittal letter.

appraisal_firm.description: Name of the appraisal firm that prepared the report.

file_number.description: The appraisal firm's file or job number for the assignment.

client_company.description: Company the appraisal was prepared for (the client).

report_date.description: Date of the report, exactly as printed, e.g. March 3, 2011.

report_format.description: Report format or reporting option, e.g. Summary, Self-Contained, Restricted.

intended_use.description: Stated intended use of the appraisal.

appraisal_standards.description: Standards or guidelines the appraisal states it conforms to, e.g. USPAP, FIRREA.

items.description: Name or acronym of one standard.

property.description: Identification and physical description of the subject property, from the Summary of Salient Facts and Identification of Subject.

street_address.description: Street address of the subject property.

zip_code.description: ZIP code of the subject property.

property_type.description: Property type exactly as printed in the Summary of Salient Facts, e.g. Office - Office.

tax_id.description: Tax ID or assessor's parcel number, exactly as printed.

gross_building_area_sf.description: Gross building area in square feet.

percent_leased.description: Percent leased, as a number from 0 to 100.

year_built.description: Year the improvements were built, from the Year Built row of the Summary of Salient Facts.

highest_and_best_use_as_vacant.description: Highest and best use as if vacant.

highest_and_best_use_as_improved.description: Highest and best use as improved.

tenancy.description: Tenancy and rent figures from the Summary of Salient Facts.

major_tenant_lease_expiration.description: Major tenant's lease expiration, exactly as printed.

average_contract_rent_psf.description: Average contract rent per square foot in dollars.

average_market_rent_psf.description: Average market rent per square foot in dollars.

value_conclusions.description: Each row of the Value Conclusions table: appraisal premise, interest appraised, date of value and value conclusion.

appraisal_premise.description: Appraisal premise, e.g. Fair Value As Is, Market Value As Is, Prospective Value Upon Stabilization.

interest_appraised.description: Property interest appraised, e.g. Fee Simple, Leased Fee.

date_of_value.description: Effective date of value, exactly as printed, e.g. March 2, 2011.

valuation_approaches.description: Value indications by approach, from the Summary of Value Indications in the reconciliation and the Salient Facts.

cost_approach_value.description: Cost approach value indication in dollars. Null when the approach is marked Not Used; never 0 for an approach that was not used.

sales_comparison_value.description: Sales comparison approach value indication in dollars.

income_capitalization_value.description: Income capitalization approach value indication in dollars.

approach_given_greatest_weight.description: The approach the appraiser gave greatest weight in reconciliation.

net_operating_income.description: Net operating income at stabilization in dollars.

capitalization_rate_percent.description: Overall capitalization rate applied, as a percent.

discount_rate_percent.description: Discount rate applied in the discounted cash flow, as a percent.

value_per_sf.description: Final value conclusion per square foot in dollars.

extraordinary_assumptions.description: Distinct extraordinary assumptions and hypothetical conditions the value conclusions are subject to. The same list is repeated in several places in the report; include each distinct assumption once only.

name.description: Appraiser's name with designations as printed.

certification.description: Certification, e.g. Certified General Real Estate Appraiser.

license_number.description: State certificate or licence number only, without the 'TX Certificate #' prefix, e.g. 1234567-G.
